name: Akuratsu ~Chijoku no Yuri Shimai~
original_name: あくらつ～恥辱の百合姉妹～
source:
This time father orders to train six half-sisters to prevent their claims to the conglomerate. This time he will be assisted by the two previously trained half-sisters.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这一次，父亲下令训练六名同父异母的姐妹，以防止她们对企业集团提出要求。这次他将得到两位先前训练过的同父异母姐妹的协助。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/11/vn-of-month-october-2005-ayakashi.html]vndbreview[/url]]
